thread:
nicole: quick check  our usability sessions flagged the red asterisk as unclear. proposing visible 'Required' token after label (low-contrast). thoughts?
ben: agree on explicit text. better for screen readers and i18n. asterisk feels decorative.
rachel: low-contrast is fine but ensure it meets 3:1 for small text. a11y-bot: scan indicates #9a9a9a for 13px fails; recommend #7a7a7a.
dev-bot: implementation note: adding visible text increases DOM slightly but negligible perf. aria-required should also be present.
nicole: validation timingblur vs submit vs live? testers disliked per-keystroke errors.
ben: hybrid: validate on blur for most fields, live for match-only cases (password confirm), and show top summary on submit with anchors to fields.
rachel: anchors should focus fields without sudden scroll; respect prefers-reduced-motion. code hint: `firstError.focus({preventScroll: true}); if (!prefersReducedMotion) firstError.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center'});`
a11y-bot: inline errors must be in DOM and use role="alert" when revealed. summary list items should be links with clear labels and visible focus. avoid announcing per-keystroke to AT.
nicole: destructive flowsdelete project. typed-confirm vs undo toast?
ben: project delete is severe. default to typed-confirm (enter project name) + soft-delete retention window (7 days). provide org setting to relax this for power users.
rachel: copy suggestion: header: "Permanently delete project" body: "Type the project name to confirm. This will permanently remove data after the retention window." CTA: "Delete project" (danger). cancel: "Keep project".
dev-bot: security note: avoid revealing password policy step-by-step during typing. show the policy but only mark as failed at submit.
nicole: agreed. rachel, can design produce compact + expanded specs (visual tokens, copy, a11y notes) so eng can implement both?
rachel: yes  i'll upload both variants and a small prototype. pairing next week. :white_check_mark:
